fields.name: stusab

fields.name: logrecno

fields.name: housing_units
fields.definition: B25001_001E; occupied plus vacant housing stock, not new construction

fields.name: housing_units_moe90
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for housing_units; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio.

fields.name: median_gross_rent
fields.definition: B25064_001E; annual current-dollar median gross rent, including applicable utilities

fields.name: median_gross_rent_moe90
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for median_gross_rent; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio.

fields.name: median_gross_rent_status
fields.definition: ok, top_coded_ge_2000 (through 2014), top_coded_ge_3500 (2015+), bottom_coded_le_100, or original missing/special-code reason.

fields.name: median_gross_rent_lower_bound
fields.definition: Exact rent, or 2000/3500 for the applicable annual top code. Not a confidence bound.

fields.name: median_gross_rent_upper_bound
fields.definition: Exact rent when available; null means no finite published upper bound for a top-coded median. Not a confidence bound

fields.name: median_gross_rent_display
fields.definition: Exact dollar number, >=2000 (through 2014), >=3500 (2015+), <=100, or empty when unavailable.

fields.name: cash_rent_households
fields.definition: B25070_001E; cash-rent renter-occupied housing units, including Not computed

fields.name: cash_rent_households_moe90
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for cash_rent_households; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio.

fields.name: rent_not_computed_households
fields.definition: B25070_011E; retained, never treated as unburdened

fields.name: rent_not_computed_households_moe90
fields.definition: Published 90% ACS margin of error for rent_not_computed_households; not a confidence interval for a derived growth/ratio.

fields.name: rent_computable_households
fields.definition: B25070_001E - B25070_011E; rent-burden denominator

fields.name: rent_burdened_households
fields.definition: Sum B25070_007E through B25070_010E; gross rent at least 30% of income

fields.name: rent_burden_pct
fields.definition: 100 * rent_burdened_households / rent_computable_households

fields.name: rent_burden_status
fields.definition: ok, missing_inputs or zero_denominator

fields.name: data_complete
fields.definition: All 13 estimates are exact numeric values and burden ratio available; comparison also requires nonzero growth bases. Censored rent rows remain in both tables with bounds. MOE availability is recorded separately in data_flags

fields.name: data_flags

storage.csv: UTF-8 with BOM; unavailable numeric values are empty fields; import identifiers as text in Excel
storage.json: UTF-8 without BOM; identifiers are strings, numeric missing values are null
storage.percentage_precision: Percentages are stored on a 0-100 scale, rounded to 6 decimal places. Do not multiply by 100 again.
storage.uncertainty: Published input MOEs are retained. Derived burden/growth MOEs are not calculated; do not reuse input MOEs as derived uncertainty.

geography_policy: User-requested: ignore boundary changes. Pair source codes/names to ten project IDs; do not interpolate, reweight, or imply equal polygons. In particular pre-2022 CD4&5 pairs to 2022+ CD4; pre-2022 CD6 pairs to CD5&6.
